rationale: manduca_bilateral-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=1.5, proj_w=5, proj_kernel=5, bf_d_w_ratio=0.16666666666666666, manduca_N0=100000.0, manduca_bowtie=False, img_n_bf=6, img_kernel=9, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.05, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=1.0, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=1600, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-14 manduca_bilateral breast (val=200). SIX-BOX from BEST (iter-8 hr=0.2771): (1) PRIOR: bowtie=True (iter-13) COLLAPSED to hr=0 ssim=0.45 (1024 per-detector log-N0 params diverged, corrupted the log-sino inversion) -> revert bowtie=False; proj-domain conclusively harmful when given DOF. All levers mapped at train_n=400. TRAIN_N (=400 throughout) UNTESTED -- coordinator allows <=2400. (2) FAILURE MODE: the 21-param image bilateral may be DATA-limited not capacity-limited -- 400 train scenes may under-determine the sigma optimum for the val=200 distribution. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 400 -> 1600 (from iter-8 best config, bowtie reverted False; 4x supervised scenes). (4) HYPOTHESIS: train_n 400->1600 lifts hr above 0.2771 because more supervised scene diversity lets the bilateral sigmas converge to a denoiser that generalizes better to val=200, IF the plateau was data- not capacity-limited. FALSIFIER: if flat, the plateau is a genuine 21-param capacity ceiling -> iters 15-20 confirm best config. (5) BUDGET: 16000 steps vs iter-4's 4000@236s -> ~950s, under 1200s (20-min). ep10 kept. (6) Loop continues; iter-15 on landing. turbo, save ckpt+recon, params_M logged.
